issuer: Service Oklahoma (driver licensing, formerly the Department of Public Safety)
note: The Class D fee sheet (Digital Driver License Classes & Fees, an undated PDF on oklahoma.gov, read 2026-10-30) gives the Class D licence fee as $38.50 and its application fee as $4.00, kept as $42.50 (their sum), and the ID card at $25.00. Service Oklahoma's unrestricted licence page gives the minimum age as 17 without driver education (16 1/2 with it); 17 is kept, as the age is held in whole years. The sheet gives no term, so both terms are null (Oklahoma issues 4- and 8-year licences; not read today).
